It is hard to reach this place but it was worth it. The cars and trucks are driving slow because they have to stop to pay toll for the road. I had a sign for Subotica and found a truck in 15 minutes that brought me to the border with Hungary.

That's why I love Balkans where you don't get 150 euros fine for doing something innocent and nobody will ever snitch on you.

comments.text: It was my first time ever to try hitchhiking and I had a sign to Zagreb. After waiting for 15 minutes 2 other hitchhikers came to the exact same spot which was nice. After 50 minutes there was finally a car that stopped and instead of Zagreb I went to Novi Sad.
The first car we asked took us to the border with Croatia. I don't knwo id there is a way to come directly here, if not you can hitchhike from the previous gas station
Most of the cars are going towards Novi Sad. We waited for more than 2 hours, and after that one macedonian guy who was driving to Swiss, brought us straight to our hometown, Postojna, Slovenija.

Took me around 45min to get a ride with a "Novi Sad" sign, but got the ride cus I was asking people directly at the same time
Was staying with a sign Sarajevo, got a ride to Bijeljina.
Its okey place to go in direction of Croatia, Cacak or Novi Sad. After 40 min with sign "Novi Sad" we got a ride where we needed.
Hopeless place if you go towards Novi Sad. Every single driver that was willing to pick me up, headed westwards or just few kilometers away from Belgrade. After 3h45m I gave up.

comments.text:
Hated this spot. Just locals going nowhere. After 2,5h waiting and asking people, I decided to get to better spot. It was indeed much better. You can walk there (40mins), or you can ask some Serbians to give you 1 minute ride. 
I don't recommend this place. Move away from here.

I had a sign with Belgrade and asked a few drivers. The third driver I asked first said no but then came back to me and told me that I could come. He was going to the outskirts of Belgrade but he told me that there where free busses.
Gas station with a lot of traffic! Asked around with a sign "Belgrade" to help me out in case they didn't speak english, and ended up getting a ride after 30min

comments.text: To arrive here you take the bus number 70 from belgrade center and get out the last stop before to arrive to IKEA and walk around 20 minutes to the Gas station and you can start HH to the south!!!, it's big gas station and crazy for HH, I hitchhiked from here to Nis, but it takes time ! People don't like foreign people, anyway, everything is about how you look and you luck !!!

Got dropped here after hitching from zagreb - made a sign "niš" and was thumbing for around 10 mins before a massive storm errupted out of nowhere, the staff were amazing, making me comfortable inside giving n free food until the storm passed. When it did, I stood at the entrance with my sign for 20 mins before a guy stopped and took me 100km further. It's not the best spot and especially after school ends, it seemed to be all family's with full cars, didn't see a single truck come through.
